objective: Read the field papers, then file an acknowledgment

order.text:

Further instructions follow as earlier ones close. Carry them out in the order given.

Elenwen

report.text:

I have read the field papers and understand the procedure for reports, replies and authority. I hold no public rank and will claim none.

objective: Deliver three bottles of Solitude spiced wine

order.title: Instruction 1002: Solitude Spiced Wine
order.text:
Buy three bottles of Solitude spiced wine and deliver them unopened through this box within ten days.

The city's own spiced wine. Not Alto, not Cyrodilic, not whatever an innkeeper calls wine.

Thirty septims should cover it. If you need an advance, request supply authority first, then collect it from Accounts, and return what you do not spend within fourteen days. A meal or a gift is not a purchase.

Elenwen

report.text:
Instruction 1002

Three bottles of Solitude spiced wine are consigned unopened with this report, bought as a private customer.

Filed by secure dispatch.

Three bottles, correct and unopened. Any claim goes to Accounts.

objective: Go to Markarth and find out what happened in the market

order.title: Instruction 1003: Trouble in Markarth
order.text:
Go to Markarth within ten days. There has been trouble in the market there, and the account that reached me is incomplete. Find out what happened, who is blamed, and who is doing the blaming.

The Embassy has a representative in Understone Keep. You will not approach him, and you will not mention the Embassy to anyone.

Elenwen

report.text:
Instruction 1003

I have been to Markarth. What happened in the market, who is blamed and who is doing the blaming are set down here. I did not approach Understone Keep or mention the Embassy.

Filed by secure dispatch.

response.title: Response 1003: Received
response.text:
Received. Whatever you are drawn into in Markarth, you are there as a private person. Remember it.

Elenwen

prompt.title: Response 1003: Prompt
prompt.text:
Received promptly. That will do. Whatever follows in Markarth, you are a private person there.

Elenwen

late.title: Response 1003: Delay Noted

extensionRequest.text:

I request five further days for this instruction. Any time granted runs from the present deadline.

extensionApproved.text:
Instruction 1003: five further days, counted from the present deadline. The road to the Reach is long. I am aware of it.

order.text:

While you are there, note who works the floor, who gives the orders, and whether anyone from Riften is about. Do not mention Riften yourself.

Deliver the bottles with your report.
